ideas.pitch: A competitive coding platform where solo developers engage in 1v1 automated code battles with strict time and memory complexity limits.
ideas.title: AlgoDuell: Real-Time Algorithmic Problem Dueling Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses purely on the core essence of CODE-A-THON 3.0 by delivering a bulletproof, sandboxed code execution pipeline that judges can test live during the presentations.

ideas.pitch: An analysis tool that parses submitted source code and instantly generates visual graphs of time complexity bottlenecks and code smells.
ideas.title: CodeLens: Automated Abstract Syntax Tree Complexity Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to computer science educators and judges by demonstrating deep algorithmic understanding and hard engineering beyond standard CRUD apps.

ideas.pitch: A secure browser extension and web app that lets developers store sensitive API keys and code snippets using client-side zero-knowledge encryption.
ideas.title: SnippetVault: Zero-Knowledge Encrypted Code Snippet Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard cryptographic engineering in a solo timeframe, directly mirroring national-level security hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A specialized developer tool that breaks down complex regular expressions into interactive state machine diagrams and tests them against edge cases in real time.
ideas.title: RegexCraft: Interactive Regular Expression Debugger and Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an everyday pain point for coders with high polish and an instantly verifiable live demo that works out of the box.

ideas.pitch: An application that ingests raw database query execution plans and utilizes local LLMs to suggest optimal indexing strategies and query rewrites.
ideas.title: QueryOptimizer: AI-Powered SQL Execution Plan Explainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical database engineering with modern AI tooling, offering immediate utility that technical judges appreciate.
